title: 十五楼

lines.text: 杰克去深圳出差，要去一家新客户的公司谈合作。客户的办公室在一座老楼的十五楼。
lines.py: Jié kè qù shēn zhèn chū chāi, yào qù yì jiā xīn kè hù de gōng sī tán hé zuò. kè hù de bàn gōng shì zài yí zuò lǎo lóu de shí wǔ lóu.
lines.en: Jack goes to Shenzhen on business to talk about working with a new client. The client's office is on the fifteenth floor of an old office building.

lines.en: The talks that day go extremely smoothly, and the contract is signed that afternoon.

lines.text: 他小声说：“原来电梯早就能告诉我，可惜我没坐上。”
